note: Rewritten from the species description in Casalla, Scheffrahn & Korb 2021, originally in English; in Table 3 of the original the maximum compound eye diameter is printed '0.30, 032', the second value lacking a decimal point through OCR, and is entered as 0.32; the original has only 2 soldiers and 2 dealated alates, so the measurements are individual values rather than statistical ranges; the text omits locality, type material, distribution, ecology, molecular and phylogenetic content, and plate and appendix information is not recorded; the comparison of the alate with R. tinto in the diagnostic characters is taken from the original key.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: The soldier is the smallest in the genus, with a markedly small head capsule; in both the soldier and the alate the pronotum is almost twice as wide as long. The soldier's antennal sockets project markedly and are rectangular, and it differs from all congeners by the small subflangular elevation, the angle of the anterolateral ridges being about 85°. The alate is also the smallest in the genus, with compound eyes and ocelli disproportionately large relative to the head capsule (compared with the equally small R. flavicinctus); the combination of a dark chestnut head capsule with a pale yellow pronotum is unique in the genus. Distinguished from R. tinto as follows: in this species the anterior part of the soldier head capsule is pale yellow orange and the angle of the anterolateral ridges is weakly developed, mean soldier head width 1.17 mm; the alate head capsule is dark chestnut, the pronotum pale yellow and the compound eyes large, mean head width 1.15 mm.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text:
Head capsule pale yellow orange in dorsal view, the occiput and posterior vertex grading from pale orange to yellow orange towards the frons. Postmentum concolorous with the head capsule, narrowest at the posterior third. Pronotum pale yellow, almost translucent towards the lateral margins. Mandibular bases dark reddish brown, black from the middle to the apex. Third antennal segment club-shaped, darker than the other segments, segmental formula 2<3>4=5. Pronotum twice as wide as long, anterior margin shallowly concave, anterolateral corners rounded, posterolateral margins with a few bristles and scattered setae. Eye spots barely discernible, appearing as pale patches behind the antennal ridges. Head capsule rectangular in dorsal view, lateral margins parallel. Frons about 30° below the plane of the vertex, weakly concave, with wavy rugae in the middle extending to the postclypeus. In frontal view a shallow swelling on each side of the frontal margin, each with about a dozen medium-length setae above and lateral to it. Anterolateral ridges about 85° in dorsal view, the angle rounded. Dorsal and posterior edges of the antennal ridges projecting but not exceeding the head width, the anterior edge lying below the anterolateral ridge. Basal swelling of the mandibles weak, the outer edge of the blade straight from the swelling to the apical quarter; the first marginal tooth of the left mandible at three-quarters of the distance from the apex, directed forward, that of the right mandible at one-third from the base.
Measurements (mm; N=2, first figure the holotype, second the values for the two specimens): head length including mandibles 2.81 (2.81—2.90), head length to lateral mandible base 1.87 (1.87—1.99), maximum head width 1.12 (1.12—1.22), head height including postmentum 1.06 (1.06—1.20), minimum postmentum width 0.22 (0.22—0.24), postmentum length 1.34 (1.34—1.38), pronotum width 1.27 (1.27—1.39), pronotum length 0.63 (0.63—0.70), third antennal segment length 0.16 (0.16—0.17), left mandible length (from dorsal process) 1.17 (1.17—1.22), frontal angle 34° (29°—34°).

sections.label: Alate
sections.text:
Head capsule dark chestnut, pronotum pale yellow, in sharp contrast to the head capsule. Compound eyes small, oval. Ocelli translucent, almost circular, one-third of their diameter from the compound eye. Antennal segments 2—4 pale yellow, the first segment darker, segments from the fifth onwards progressively darker; at least 10 segments (broken), segmental formula 1>2=3>4. Vertex and frons with a few short setae. Pronotum twice as wide as long and wider than the head capsule, anterior margin straight, posterolateral corners rounded and with scattered bristles, posterior margin narrowly concave. Legs pale brown, progressively paler yellow towards the tibiae. Arolium present.
Measurements (mm; N=2, individual values of the two specimens): maximum compound eye diameter 0.30—0.32, maximum ocellus diameter 0.09—0.10, maximum head width (including compound eyes) 1.10—1.20, head length to apex 1.44—1.49, head height 0.78—0.87, maximum pronotum width 1.25—1.27, minimum pronotum length 0.64—0.70.
